slides.title: The clocks go back soon. Here's how I'll spend the free hour.
slides.sub: Spoiler: not on a deep clean

slides.title: Split it into four 15s
slides.body: One hour feels huge and scary. Four 15-minute blocks feel doable. Take breaks in between.

slides.title: Block 1: the entryway
slides.body: Shoes in a bin, coats on hooks. It's the first thing you see in the dark at 5pm.

slides.title: Block 2: change the bulbs
slides.body: Swap any dead bulbs now. A bright room makes evening tidying feel less gloomy.

slides.title: Block 3: the evening landing spot
slides.body: Clear one counter where keys, mail and bags land after dark.

slides.title: Block 4: rest on purpose
slides.body: The last 15 is yours. Tea, couch, blanket. That counts too.

slides.title: A free hour doesn't owe anyone a clean house.
Want a 7-day version of this?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.

caption:
Clocks go back and my brain says 'bonus hour = fix everything.' Nope.
What would you do with one free hour when the clocks change?
